agent_explanation: Body 0 gains vx~35.2 after early collisions and flies to the right boundary. At step 74 its edge already exceeds x=20 yet vx is unchanged (+35.21) and it exits further by step 75, i.e. boundary contact produced no impulse/reflection at this dt. Reducing only dt to 0.001 eliminates the failure, indicating discrete boundary-collision handling misses the impact at high speed/coarse dt.
